description: This file defines the PIM Report Menu configurator class for the OrangeHRM system. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and assigns a specific screen override for report viewing within the PIM module.

classes.name: PimReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings for PIM reports, overriding the screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports' when invoked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports' for the given Screen object, and returns null.
